methods.label: Count eliminated teams
methods.explanation:
Count the teams that must be eliminated, since every game eliminates exactly one team. When the winner is determined, only one of the sixteen teams remains, so \(16-1=15\) teams have been eliminated.

Each eliminated team loses in exactly one game because it cannot play again after losing. Thus every game accounts for one different eliminated team, and every eliminated team is accounted for. The number of games is therefore \(15\), choice D.
